name: isDeletionRetentionPeriodEnforced
definition: Every immutable or locked backup target enforces a retention period during which data cannot be deleted.
population: the backup storage targets the integration lists that have immutability or object lock on
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A target listing in which every locked target shows an enforced default retention mode and period.
citations: Backblaze B2 native API reference, b2_list_buckets: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-list-buckets

changeLog.change: Registered with the Backblaze B2 transforms. Other backup integrations already emit this key; their meaning is not yet validated against this entry.

notes: Backblaze B2: each bucket with Object Lock on must have a defaultRetention mode and period. No Object Lock bucket at all is False.
